mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS declines (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 4.5% over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate signal restrictive monetary policy combined with labor market weakness, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE increase (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a housing starts decline below 1.25 million units signals weakening consumer demand and reduced economic momentum, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in late-cycle expansion when HOUST < 1.25 million (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production growth over the past quarter indicates robust supply chain conditions and strong corporate output, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO increases (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 1.2 million units signals immediate contraction in the housing sector, reducing consumer confidence and retail sales, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1200 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and GDP growth (GDPC1) signal a broad-based economic slowdown, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both RSAFS and GDPC1 decline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes, a CPI rate above 4.0% per annum signals persistent inflation prompting aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative in high inflation regimes when CPIAUCSL > 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
